title: Record of processing activities (Article 30) - PRG32 Construction Kit, field level
owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
status: TEMPLATE for the deploying school or operator: the kit's behaviour is described exactly; legal decisions are proposals
controller: the school or operator running the kit (fill in: name, address, contact, DPO)

items.data: who a person is in the kit
items.purpose: sign in; keep each person's work theirs; teachers' roles
items.legal_basis: Art. 6(1)(e) public task of the school (or 6(1)(b)/(f) for a private operator); PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.special_categories: none collected; usernames should not reveal health, religion or similar (notice to staff)
items.access: the person; administrators; teachers see usernames of their class members
items.recipients: the Cartridge Store when shared accounts are on (sso.py); the hosting provider (processor)
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
items.retention: while the account exists; switched-off accounts are listed for review (retention.py)
items.deletion: erasure request (privacy.erase_account) or the administrator's delete with items
items.transfers: none by the kit; Cartridge Store only if the operator runs it outside the EEA
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: passwords, API tokens and sign-up links (all stored as hashes)
items.purpose: authentication; scripted access the person asked for
items.legal_basis: same as account; PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.access: nobody reads them in clear: only hashes are stored; the person lists and revokes their tokens
items.recipients: an email provider (SMTP, processor) carries the sign-up link
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
items.retention: tokens until revoked or expired; sign-up links one day after expiry or use (retention.py)
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: the school sign-in link: issuer, subject, email
items.purpose: school sign-in (ADR-0016), never joining accounts by email
items.legal_basis: Art. 6(1)(e) (school) ; PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.recipients: none: the identity provider sent it
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
items.deletion: erasure; unlinking on the Account page
items.transfers: none by the kit (the identity provider is the school's own processor)
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: classes and who is in them, with their role
items.purpose: teachers supervising their students' work (read only)
items.legal_basis: Art. 6(1)(e) (school); PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.special_categories: none; class names should not reveal special needs
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
items.deletion: erasure removes membership; teachers delete classes
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: games, block programs, source code, sprites, sounds, assets and their history
items.purpose: making games: the teaching activity itself
items.legal_basis: Art. 6(1)(e) (school); PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.special_categories: none expected; free text (titles, author, comments in code) may contain anything a student types: notices ask for nicknames
items.access: the owner; teachers of their classes (read only); administrators
items.recipients: the Cartridge Store when the person publishes; their own cloud account when they connect one
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
items.retention: until deleted; 'Recently deleted' for PRG32_KIT_TRASH_DAYS (30) then removed
items.transfers: only by the person's own choice (cloud, publishing)
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: builds, compiler logs, generated C and assembly, cartridges, debug maps, uploaded files
items.legal_basis: as student work; PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.recipients: none; the build sandbox has no network
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md); files in <data>/builds/<build_id>/ and <data>/artifacts/
items.retention: the newest PRG32_KIT_KEEP_BUILDS (10) builds per project
items.deletion: retention; erasure (with their folders and files)
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: connected Google Drive or OneDrive account and which projects are synced
items.purpose: copies of the person's own games in their own cloud folder (ADR-0019)
items.legal_basis: Art. 6(1)(a) consent of the person (or a parent, below the national age: decisions.md); PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.access: the person; tokens are encrypted and never shown to anyone
items.recipients: Google or Microsoft, chosen by the person
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md); the copies are in the person's own cloud account
items.retention: until disconnected; tokens are revoked at Google on disconnect
items.transfers: Google LLC / Microsoft Corp.: EU-US Data Privacy Framework and SCCs; transfer assessment in processors_and_transfers.md
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: Store profiles (with the Store's bearer token, encrypted at rest and never returned by the API) and what was published where
items.purpose: publishing games to the Cartridge Store, each version once
items.legal_basis: Art. 6(1)(e) or (a) depending on whether publishing is part of the course; PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
items.deletion: erasure; the Store's copies are listed for its operator
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: audit events (who did what, when, from which address; API-token use; sign-ins from new addresses) and sign-in counters (hashed)
subjects: everyone who signs in or tries to
items.legal_basis: Art. 6(1)(c)/(e) or (f): security of processing; PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
items.deletion: retention; erasure pseudonymises the person and drops their address
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: account changes waiting to reach the Cartridge Store; used single sign-on tickets
items.purpose: one account for the kit and the Cartridge Store (shared accounts, optional)
items.legal_basis: as account; PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.access: nobody reads it; the kit sends it
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
items.retention: until delivered; tickets until they expire (minutes)
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: which notice versions a person was shown; rights requests and their outcome
items.purpose: showing that notices were given and requests answered (Art. 5(2), 12)
items.legal_basis: Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation; PROPOSED - not decided: the controller confirms with its DPO (decisions.md)
items.special_categories: the free-text details may hold anything: staff keep them short
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
items.retention: notices: while the account exists; open requests always; answered requests PRG32_KIT_PRIVACY_REQUEST_DAYS after the answer (0 = keep; the controller decides, decisions.md D-5), under a pseudonym after erasure
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

items.data: school sign-in settings, the admin Settings page values (sealed secrets) and group names (no person)
items.location: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
items.review_owner: the operator's privacy lead (name it in decisions.md)
items.next_review: 2027-10-21 or on any change to the kit's data model

other_stores.data: signed session cookie: account id, session number, sign-in time
other_stores.deletion: signing out; ending all sessions; erasure invalidates it

other_stores.data: IndexedDB prg32-kit-guest: guest games; localStorage prg32-*: code view per project, debugger breakpoints and view, last AudioStudio project, storage notice read (list on /privacy#storage)
other_stores.deletion: the person (Clear site data); never sent to the server for guests

other_stores.data: static files only, never signed-in pages
<data>/builds/<build_id>/: sources and outputs of one build
other_stores.where: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)

other_stores.data: <data>/artifacts/: uploads and AudioStudio samples (one folder per owner)
other_stores.where: the server chosen by the operator (configure in the EU/EEA, see processors_and_transfers.md)
other_stores.deletion: with the artifact (retention.delete_artifact); erasure removes the owner's sample folder

other_stores.data: tools/backup_restore.py archives: the whole database, folders and the secret key
other_stores.where: chosen by the operator; keep encrypted, in the EEA
other_stores.deletion: prune; after a restore, prg32-privacy-reapply with the erasure register

other_stores.data: web server and proxy access logs (addresses, times, paths), application errors
other_stores.retention: set by the operator: recommended 14 days (retention.md)

other_stores.where: the operator's SMTP provider and the person's mailbox

other_stores.data: single sign-on tickets and OAuth codes and tokens, in transit
other_stores.where: between the browser, the kit, the Store and the providers (HTTPS)
other_stores.retention: minutes; refresh tokens encrypted at rest (cloud)

other_stores.data: screenshots, logs and recordings kept as release evidence (docs/evidence)
other_stores.deletion: never contains real people: synthetic users only (visual manifest checks)
